output.summary: Every piece of inflation evidence points the same direction: hawkish. The deterministic pre-read shows a 12-month anchor of 3.008 against a 2.0 goal (gap of 1.008 pp), with momentum (3m 2.046, 6m 2.744) and 12m CPI of 2.763 all above goal. The September SEP revised PCE inflation up for 2026 (to 3.7 from 3.6) and core PCE up (to 3.4 from 3.3). Both the July and September statements say "Inflation remains elevated," and the September statement ties its rate hike to a "timelier return to the Committee's 2 percent goal." On inflation alone this argues for continued tightening (a hike), so the net tilt is clearly hawkish, set at +7 bp.
